# WritersLogic Holographic Memory (HMS)

Hybrid search, graph indexing, and vector-symbolic memory.

> Local, encrypted, provenance-aware memory for AI agents. HMS is an open-source Rust engine for search and memory that runs inside your app, on your machine. It makes no service calls and sends no telemetry.

HMS is made by WritersLogic, Inc. (https://writerslogic.com).

## What it is

- Embeddable memory for AI agents: hybrid search (BM25 plus the embeddings you supply), vector-symbolic fact memory, optional encryption at rest and signed provenance, in one Rust library.
- Runs in-process. Embeddings are supplied by you or computed by local models from weights you provide; it never downloads a model.
- Python applications use holographic-sdk, an HTTP client for the hms-server binary.
- WritersLogic Holographic Memory Cloud (in development) adds encrypted sync, backup and independent verification. Memory stays on your machines.

## License

The source on main is Apache-2.0. Packages published so far (crate 0.6.1, holographic-sdk 0.1.2 on PyPI) were released under AGPL-3.0-or-later and stay available under those terms.
